text.en: Save and fill your Notes account name and password with your Android password manager.
text.zh: 支持通过 Android 系统密码管理器保存并自动填充 Notes 账号和密码。

text.en: On builds connected to Notes authentication, sign in with an account name and password without providing an email address, or with a passkey on supported devices. Find account, general, security, and app settings under clear section headings.
text.zh: 接入 Notes 认证服务的版本支持使用账户名和密码登录，无需提供邮箱。符合条件的设备也可以使用通行密钥登录。设置页用标题区分账户、通用、安全和应用。

text.en: Enable biometric unlock in Settings to verify with biometrics or your device screen lock when the app starts. If the device has no secure screen lock, the unlock screen explains how to restore access.
text.zh: 可在设置中开启生物识别解锁，启动应用时使用生物识别或设备锁屏凭据验证。设备未设置安全锁屏时，解锁页会提示如何恢复访问。

text.en: Let dialogs fit their content up to 80% of the app window width, preserving minimum margins and keeping long content clear of system bars.
text.zh: 弹窗按内容需要展开，最大宽度为应用窗口的 80%，保留默认最小边距，长内容避开状态栏和底部系统区域。

text.en: Generate theme colors from the desktop wallpaper, including on Android 9–11.
text.zh: 主题色直接跟随桌面壁纸变化，并支持 Android 9–11。

text.en: Open-source notices use fixed detail pages and display only the selected declaration.
text.zh: 开源软件声明使用固定详情页，每次仅显示所选声明。

text.en: Group open-source notices into Google / JetBrains components and other third-party components, with shortcut buttons at the top.
text.zh: 开源软件声明按 Google / JetBrains 组件和其他第三方组件分类展示，顶部增加分类定位按钮。

text.en: Open-source notices share one set of actions per project series, with all included modules displayed above the actions.
text.zh: 开源软件声明同系列库共用一组按钮，包含的模块完整显示在按钮上方。

text.en: Settings selection dialogs remain visible after rotating to a shorter window without needing to scroll.
text.zh: 修复设置选择弹窗在旋转到较矮窗口后需要滚动才能恢复显示的问题。

text.en: Release notes use bold category headings and list additions, improvements, then fixes.
text.zh: 更新内容分类标题加粗，统一按新增、优化、修复的顺序展示。

text.en: About app content scrolls behind the bottom safe area and keeps its scroll position when returning from open-source notices.
text.zh: 关于应用内容延伸至底部安全区域，修复从开源软件声明返回后滚动位置改变的问题。

text.en: View release notes offline from About app.
text.zh: 在关于应用中离线查看版本更新日志。

text.en: Release history adapts to wide windows with a multi-column waterfall layout.
text.zh: 历史更新根据窗口宽度自适应展示为单列、双列或三列瀑布流。

text.en: Current-version notes, the startup dialog and release history now show the same categories and content.
text.zh: 统一关于应用、启动弹窗与历史更新的分类和内容展示。

text.en: On unfolded foldables, switch between one column and hinge-aligned columns with a rotating icon.
text.zh: 折叠设备全开时默认单列，点击右上角图标切换铰链分列，图标带旋转过渡。

text.en: Release cards fill their available pane width while preserving hinge clearance.
text.zh: 历史更新卡片铺满所属窗格的可用宽度，并保留铰链避让。

text.en: Keep hinge-aligned release cards stable during predictive back gestures.
text.zh: 修复预测性返回手势导致铰链分列卡片宽度与文字换行变化。

text.en: See what’s new on the first launch of each app version.
text.zh: 每个版本首次启动时弹窗展示本次更新内容。

text.en: Keep dialogs centered when the system gesture indicator is hidden.
text.zh: 修复隐藏系统手势提示线时弹窗未居中的问题。
